changelog: Chat Effects: Express yourself with fun new visual effects triggered by chat commands.
New /users Command: Easily see everyone currently present in your space.
Command Fixes: Slash commands now work smoothly with usernames that have spaces or emojis.

features.title: What's New
items: Interactive Chat Effects: Bring your chat to life with visual effects using new slash commands.
List Active Users: Use the new /users command to quickly view all members in your current space.

features.title: Better Experience
items: Smarter Command Parsing: Improved slash command processing for seamless chat interactions.

features.title: Bug Fixes
items: Username Support: Fixed an issue where slash commands failed when targeting usernames with spaces or emojis.
